# `subject.insights`

Return a SubjectInsightBundle/v1 for an EXTERNAL subject. Refuses for OPERATOR subjects.

- **group:** `read`
- **posture:** `safe`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice subject-insights`
- **MCP tool:** `subject_insights`

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject_id` | `str` | required |  |
| `purpose` | `str` | required |  |

## Examples

```
operator-voice subject-insights --subject-id subj_abc123 --purpose '<purpose>'
```

_Synthesized from this operation's required arguments._

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |
| `unknown_subject` | No registered subject has that id — nothing changed. |
| `external_only` | This describes someone else (an EXTERNAL subject); it refuses your own OPERATOR subject. |
| `subject_not_enrolled` | That person has no approved analysis purpose enrolled yet, so analysis is refused. |

## Plain-language aliases

- "analyze how this person writes"
- "insights about a person"
- "how does this person communicate"
